title: Additivity of the matrix character
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A,B,C$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb F_2$. The sum of the entrywise products of $A$ with $B+C$ equals the sum of the entrywise products of $A$ with $B$, plus the sum of the entrywise products of $A$ with $C$.
